name: topic-hub
title: Topic hub header
description: The top of a topic page: description, a fact strip, a numbered Start here reading path and related topics as chips.
docs: title is the topic's name and the page's h1 by default; set headingLevel to 2 when the page already has one (the Start here panel and the related topics sit one level below). facts are label and value pairs: articles, contributors, a time element for the last update. startHere takes three to five pieces with a title, href, reading time in minutes and a line about them; it is an ordered list, so the sequence is announced, and each row is one stretched link. related are chips that link to their own hubs, with an optional count that is read out in words. children is placed under the related topics for the latest articles or a newsletter form. Pass linkAs={Link} to route the links and labels to translate the fixed words.
